speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin our evaluation of your dermatological condition, please describe the appearance, size, and any changes you have noticed in the lesions on your skin.

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma.

Based on your 62-year-old age, heavy smoking history, recent migration from a region with high UV exposure, and the specific presentation of non-healing, red, crusty lesions on both the penis and finger, I strongly suspect Squamous Cell Carcinoma. To confirm this, I am requesting a biopsy of the penile lesion and an examination of the lesion on your finger.
